edges.notes: api('/me') wrapper (src/shared/api/api.ts fetch(BASE_URL + path)); BASE_URL = NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, no fallback, .env.example http://localhost:3000/api (next dev default port, no basePath). app/api/me/route.ts export async function GET
